pending_commit.commit_message: coral: chromeos-config dep on chromeos-bsp-coral. In some cases, while building packages for coral, we would fail with a stacktrace shown below because /usr/share/chromeos-config/config.dtb did not exist. To ensure it gets populated before running the installation of chromeos-bsp-coral, add a dependency on chromeos-config. In addition, the unibuild USE flag must be set in public, since otherwise a lot of the dependencies in the system won't be correct, e.g. the media-sound/adhd package won't depend on chromeos-config as it should. Stacktrace: chromeos-bsp-coral-0.0.1-r3: >>> Install chromeos-bsp-coral-0.0.1-r3 into /build/coral/tmp/portage/chromeos-base/chromeos-bsp-coral -0.0.1-r3/image/ category chromeos-base chromeos-bsp-coral-0.0.1-r3: * chromeos-bsp-coral-0.0.1-r3: * unibuild: Installing audio files chromeos-bsp-coral-0.0.1-r3: Traceback (most recent call last): chromeos-bsp-coral-0.0.1-r3: File "/usr/lib/python-exec/python2.7/cros_config_host", line 9, in <module> chromeos-bsp-coral-0.0.1-r3: load_entry_point('cros-config-host==1', 'console_scripts', 'cros_config_host')() chromeos-bsp-coral-0.0.1-r3: File "/usr/lib64/python2.7/site-packages/cros_config_host/cros_config_host.py", line 346, in main chromeos-bsp-coral-0.0.1-r3: not opts.nocompare_formats and opts.config != '-') chromeos-bsp-coral-0.0.1-r3: File "/usr/lib64/python2.7/site-packages/cros_config_host/libcros_config_host.py", line 1293, in Cro sConfig chromeos-bsp-coral-0.0.1-r3: infile = open(fname) chromeos-bsp-coral-0.0.1-r3: IOError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '/build/coral/usr/share/chromeos-config/config.dtb' BUG=b:75308220 TEST=Ran emerge-coral chromeos-base/chromeos-bsp-coral, which had been broken. cros tryjob: Add --json option. Add a new option "--json" to output information about scheduled jobs in json format. This is intended to make it easier for scripts that invoke tryjobs to parse the results. If "cros tryjob" fails for any reason, the output will NOT be json. Sample json: cros tryjob --yes --swarming success-build fail-build [ { "build_config": "success-build", "buildbucket_id": "8952660457862247296", "url": "<long_url_shortened>" }, { "build_config": "fail-build", "buildbucket_id": "8952660457215487216", "url": "<long_url_shortened>" } ] This was previously submitted and reverted. The dependency on the PreCQLauncher change should make this safe. firmware: tpm2_lite: propagate actual errors Propagate the actual error - a non-successful response code from the tpm or communication/serializing failure - to the caller of the Tlcl functions in TPM 2.0 case. Currently, the callers only have special processing for the error codes from TCG TPM 1.2 range, which are never returned in case of communication or serialization failures or from the actual TPM 2.0. (The only case of mapping TPM 2.0 error codes to TPM_E_BADINDEX is preserved in this CL.) Thus, changing the actual values returned from the functions won't change any current behavior in the calling layers. This CL is a preparatory work for adding special processing for communication errors in mount-encrypted. BUG=chromium:702724 BRANCH=none TEST=build; test that tpmc getvf, tpmc read still work. cryptohome: Generate reset seed for Credentials This patch generates a reset seed in a VaultKeyset. This reset seed is then used to generate a reset secret which can be used to unlock a Low Entropy (LE) credential that has been locked out. The reset seed is generated as follows: During Homedirs::AddKeyset() we check if the existing VaultKeyset has a wrapped_reset_seed(). If it doesn't, we generate a random 32-byte reset seed in the VaultKeyset, and then re-encrypt the same credential, so that it is persisted to disk, and made part of the SerializedVaultKeyset. If a reset seed is already present, we don't do anything. The rest of the AddKeyset() function proceeds as before. The reset_seed will then be used by EncryptLECredential() to generate a reset_secret with which the LE credential is stored. BUG=chromium:794010,chromium:809723 TEST=cros_run_unit_tests passes. Change-Id: I2bd025ef672294381cc7baf7503caaddb2bd68d7 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/955283 Commit-Ready: Prashant Malani <pmalani@google.com> Tested-by: Prashant Malani <pmalani@google.com> Reviewed-by: Andrey Pronin <apronin@chromium.org>

[autotest] Change update command execution in deploy_production_local. Various commands in the [UPDATE_COMMANDS] section in global_config.ini need to refer to content in the local autotest repository. Previously, that was done by having deploy_server_local replace the special string "AUTOTEST_REPO" with the path to the directory. This change drops the old behavior in favor of just allowing commands in [UPDATE_COMMANDS] to assume that the current directory is the Autotest repository.
